verdict.rationale: PayPal's developer hub documents an in-browser API Explorer for testing queries, but only for Braintree's GraphQL API. For the core PayPal REST APIs, the evidence shows only browsable API descriptions and OpenAPI documents to import into third-party tools, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: an interactive, runnable reference for the PayPal REST APIs themselves, documented runnable code samples in the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: an in-browser API Explorer for testing queries, and an end-to-end example integration
